hooks.command: c=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if printf '%s' "$c" | grep -Eq '(^|[^[:alnum:]])(git|gh)[[:space:]]' && printf '%s' "$c" | grep -Eiq 'co-authored-by:.*(claude|anthropic|openai|codex|chatgpt|gemini|copilot|grok|kimi)|claude-session:|generated (with|by) .*(claude|openai|codex|chatgpt|gemini|copilot|grok|kimi)|noreply@anthropic'; then echo 'Blocked: no AI attribution in commits, comments or PR bodies in this repo.' >&2; exit 2; fi
